_meta.indication: BRINTELLIX is indicated for the treatment of major depressive disorder (MDD).

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled, parallel-group, fixed-dose 8-week study; patients randomized 1:1:1:1 to placebo, Lu AA21004 15 mg, Lu AA21004 20 mg, or duloxetine 60 mg (active reference).
pivotal_trials.population: Adult subjects with major depressive disorder (MDD); enrolled at 58 US sites.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Mean change from baseline in MADRS total score at Week 8.
pivotal_trials.n: Placebo N=158, duloxetine N=146, Lu AA21004 15 mg N=149, 20 mg N=151.
pivotal_trials.result: Both doses statistically superior to placebo on MADRS change at Week 8: LS mean difference from placebo -5.5 (15 mg) and -7.1 points (20 mg), both p<0.0001. The duloxetine arm, included as an active reference (not a comparator the study was powered against), showed an LS mean difference from placebo of -9.5 (p<0.0001).

pivotal_trials.design: Multicenter, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled, fixed-dose 8-week study; patients randomized 1:1:1 to Lu AA21004 10 mg, Lu AA21004 20 mg, or placebo.
pivotal_trials.population: Adult subjects with MDD; enrolled at 37 US sites.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Mean change from baseline in MADRS total score at Week 8.
pivotal_trials.n: Placebo N=155, Lu AA21004 10 mg N=154, 20 mg N=148.
pivotal_trials.result: Lu AA21004 20 mg was statistically superior to placebo on MADRS change at Week 8 (LS mean difference -3.6 points, p=0.002); the 10 mg dose was not significantly different from placebo (difference -2.2, p=0.058).

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (incidence ≥5% and at least twice placebo) were nausea, constipation and vomiting. Nausea was dose-dependent: 21% (5 mg), 26% (10 mg), 32% (15 mg) and 32% (20 mg) versus 9% placebo. The most common AE leading to discontinuation was nausea (vortioxetine 2.2%, duloxetine 3.5%, placebo 0.3%).
target_moa: Serotonergic antidepressant; mechanism not fully understood but likely related to enhancement of serotonergic activity via blocking of serotonin reuptake (SSRI action); also an antagonist at 5-HT3 receptors.

boxed_warning.content: Boxed warning: Suicidal thoughts and behaviors — antidepressants increased the risk of suicidal thinking and behavior in children, adolescents, and young adults; monitor for worsening and emergence of suicidal thoughts and behaviors.

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee was convened; the clinical trial designs were similar to previously approved MDD products and the data did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues.

The application was submitted on October 2, 2012, and has a PDUFA goal date of October 2, 2013.
This new drug application provides for the use of Brintellix (vortioxetene) tablets for the treatment of major depressive disorder (MDD).

Your application for Brintellix (vortioxetine) was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because the clinical trial designs are similar to previously approved products for the treatment of major depressive disorder. Additionally, evaluation of the effectiveness and safety data did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues in the adult major depressive disorder population.
